msg_subject_1: Your products, in their own room
msg_body_1:
Hello Frederic,

41zero42.com shows the collections well, and then the visit ends at a catalogue.

What it can't do is show someone your product in the room they're standing in. So they look, decide, and go.

Showhouse sits on 41zero42.com under your own branding, so nobody sees our name. A visitor photographs their room and your product appears in it. Or they describe what they're imagining and it's generated from your real collections and finishes.

Visitors also stay on the page instead of bouncing, and every render builds visual content around your own products.

We load your actual catalogue first, so nothing renders that you can't make. It goes live in weeks.

Try it on a photo of your own room: https://www.tryshowhouse.com/tile

Want one with 41Zero42 products in it? Send me a collection name.

Haroon
Showhouse

Hello Kamil,

tarmakusa.com shows the collections well, and then the visit ends at a catalogue.

What it can't do is show someone your product in the room they're standing in. So they look, decide, and go.

Showhouse sits on tarmakusa.com under your own branding, so nobody sees our name. A visitor photographs their room and your product appears in it. Or they describe what they're imagining and it's generated from your real collections and finishes.

The image only unlocks once they confirm their email. So you get a lead: the render, a short brief in their own words, and a verified address, all in one dashboard.

Visitors also stay on the page instead of bouncing, and every render builds visual content around your own products.

We load your actual catalogue first, so nothing renders that you can't make. It goes live in weeks.

Try it on a photo of your own room: https://www.tryshowhouse.com/tile

Want one with Tarmak USA products in it? Send me a collection name.

Haroon
Showhouse

the spec: herringbone, Carrara and cream, polished, 600x300
